name: es30-uniform-buffer-objects
title: Uniform buffer objects
summary: Uniform blocks: std140 offsets/strides of scalars, vec3 packing, arrays, matrices, row_major, structs and arrays of structs compared with a CPU layout calculator and with glGetActiveUniformsiv, data packed by that calculator and verified by the shader (green/red cells), a deliberate layout mistake, a packed block laid out from queried offsets, block introspection, glUniformBlockBinding, glBindBufferBase/Range with the offset alignment, one buffer shared by two programs, updates between draws, an array of blocks, limits and errors.
spec: ES 3.0 §2.12.6 Uniform Variables (§2.12.6.2 Uniform Blocks, §2.12.6.3 Uniform Buffer Object Storage, §2.12.6.4 Standard Uniform Block Layout, §2.12.6.5 Uniform Buffer Object Bindings)
ES 3.0 §2.12.3 Program Objects (names of active uniforms and blocks)
ES 3.0 §2.10.1.1 Binding Buffer Objects to Indexed Targets
ES 3.0 §6.1.1 Simple Queries (indexed state), §6.1.9 Buffer Object Queries, Tables 6.21, 6.25, 6.31-6.33
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.3.7 Interface Blocks, §4.3.8.3 Uniform Block Layout Qualifiers

api.glGetUniformBlockIndex: block names resolve to indices (also "Tint[0]"/"Tint[1]"); the instance name and an unknown name give INVALID_INDEX without an error
api.glGetActiveUniformBlockiv: UNIFORM_BLOCK_DATA_SIZE equals the CPU std140 size (736, 48, 64), BINDING (0 after link, set value after glUniformBlockBinding), ACTIVE_UNIFORMS, ACTIVE_UNIFORM_INDICES equals the indices of the 30 member names, REFERENCED_BY_VERTEX/FRAGMENT_SHADER per program, NAME_LENGTH; invalid index -> INVALID_VALUE and nothing written
api.glGetActiveUniformBlockName: block name (not the instance name), length, truncation with bufSize 4, "Tint[0]"; invalid index -> INVALID_VALUE and nothing written
api.glGetUniformIndices: 30 member names of Probe (arrays as name[0], struct-array elements separately), "Tint.color"; an unknown name gives INVALID_INDEX
api.glGetActiveUniformsiv: UNIFORM_TYPE, SIZE, BLOCK_INDEX, OFFSET, ARRAY_STRIDE, MATRIX_STRIDE, IS_ROW_MAJOR of 30 members equal the CPU std140 calculator; packed block queried and used for packing; index >= ACTIVE_UNIFORMS -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glUniformBlockBinding: moves blocks to binding points 3, 4, 6, 8-13; read back with UNIFORM_BLOCK_BINDING and observed through the data the draws use; inactive block / binding >= MAX -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glBindBufferBase: whole-buffer binding: draws read the buffer start; UNIFORM_BUFFER_START/SIZE read 0 afterwards; index >= MAX_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BINDINGS -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glBindBufferRange: four aligned slots of one buffer drawn; START/SIZE read back; misaligned offset, size 0, index >= MAX -> INVALID_VALUE and the binding is unchanged; a negative offset is checked (XFAIL on Mesa)
api.glGetIntegeri_v: UNIFORM_BUFFER_BINDING / START / SIZE of the bound points; index >= MAX_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BINDINGS -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glGetInteger64i_v: UNIFORM_BUFFER_START / SIZE of the bound points; out-of-range index -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glGetProgramiv: ACTIVE_UNIFORM_BLOCKS (3, 2), ACTIVE_UNIFORM_BLOCK_MAX_NAME_LENGTH, ACTIVE_UNIFORMS; link status of the limit programs
api.glLinkProgram: a fragment shader with MAX_FRAGMENT_UNIFORM_BLOCKS blocks links, one with MAX+1 fails
api.glGetUniformLocation: block members have no location (-1); u_cell / u_height located
api.glUniform1i: u_cell, u_height: the verification grid cells land where the shader and the probes expect them
api.glBufferData: initial block data (observed through the shader's green cells and the scene pixels)
api.glBufferSubData: updates between draws change the next draw (palette and ring slots); a corrupted member turns its cell red
api.glMapBufferRange: partial update of a bound uniform buffer (offset, gain, pick) changes the next draw
api.glUseProgram: four programs: verification, palette (both stages), palette inverse (fragment only), block array
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLES (fullscreen triangle) and TRIANGLE_STRIP (4-vertex squares); every cell probed
api.glViewport: verification band and per-cell scene viewports
api.glScissor: restricts the two wrong-layout panels to their own cells; per-cell clears
api.glClearColor: background pixels equal the clear colors
api.glClear: COLOR_BUFFER_BIT, also per cell through the scissor
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of every probed pixel
api.glCopyBufferSubData: C5: a slot of the ring buffer is copied over the whole palette block; the next draw shows the slot's data

visual_review.notes: Viewed gpu es-max and zink es-max captures (256x256, identical): top 64 px verification grid - rows 0 and 1 are all green (30 Probe cells, last two cells of row 1 dark); row 2 has five green cells, a dark gap, three green and two magenta (C-struct packing); row 3 has one green and four magenta (padded vec3), a dark gap and six green (packed block). Below, three rows of 32-px scene cells: small colored squares at different offsets (red, magenta, green, orange, dark blue, lime, teal, purple, yellow, pink), big inverse-colored squares for program 2 (pink, blue, beige with a small dark-blue square on top, purple), and two split cells (orange|blue, green|yellow) for the block array. Lower ~100 px intentionally empty (dark).
